_provenance.supersedes: The six objectives O1-O6 of the Master Draft configuration (fieldwise-run-01). The Pack §1.1.8 objectives table carries four objectives O1-O4; RQ and hypothesis sets shrink to RQ1-RQ5 and H1-H4 (Pack §1.1.6, §1.1.7).
_provenance.field_mapping: The Pack's objectives table columns are Objective | Purpose | Verification / output (§1.1.8). title is the Purpose column; measurable_output is the Verification/output column. addressed_by_work_packages and target_month come from the §3.1 work-package block and milestone lines. linked_research_questions and linked_hypotheses are Inferred: the Pack states RQ1-RQ5 and H1-H4 but does not cross-link them to objectives; the links below are derivations from subject-matter identity, and each objective's note states the derivation. Statuses: title/measurable_output/WPs/months are Confirmed (Pack-stated); the RQ/H links are Inferred.
_provenance.partner_tokens: involved_partners uses the fieldwise-run-02 role tokens (HOST = HUN-REN ATK, EO_PARTNER = ELTE, DATA_PARTNER = MATE, SOFTWARE_PARTNER = Krumatic, VALIDATION_PARTNER = AgroVIR, VALIDATION_SITE = commercial farmer). Tokens list the organisations the cited WP month-lines name; the FELLOW executes all work packages and is not repeated per objective.

objectives.title: Harmonise the heterogeneous 2022-2026 MATE archive and define a physiologically meaningful water-stress target
objectives.measurable_output: QC-controlled common-variable matrix; missingness/measurement-frequency map; target and validation protocol
objectives.source_ref: Pack §1.1.8 (O1 row); §3.1 WP1; target month M6->M2 per the OD-1 partner-backed answer (2026-09-02, MS1 at M2)
objectives.note: RQ1/H1 link Inferred: RQ1 asks which variables of the 2022-2026 archive most robustly indicate developing stress, and H1 is the physiological-signature hypothesis — both are what the O1 target definition operationalises.

objectives.title: Develop a parsimonious, interpretable and uncertainty-aware predictive framework under HUN-REN supervision, with ELTE spectral/EO harmonisation, and separate reusable system components from crop-specific biological/calibration parameters
objectives.measurable_output: Ranked predictor set; primary model and nonlinear benchmark where justified; calibration/uncertainty assessment; model card; crop-transfer specification
objectives.source_ref: Pack §1.1.8 (O2 row); §3.1 former WP2 block, merged into WP1 per OD-1 (2026-09-02); model tasks freeze at MS6 (M3), scale/crop-transfer work runs to MS2 (M14)
objectives.note: RQ2 (parsimonious process-informed/AI-supported prediction) and RQ4 (cross-scale translation toward Sentinel-2) are the merged WP1's modelling and scale strands (T2.1-T2.4); H3 is the scale-transition hypothesis. Links Inferred from subject identity. Under OD-1 the primary model is frozen and registered at M3 (MS6); the M14 target month covers the scale-transition framework and crop-transfer specification.

objectives.title: Prospectively validate the framework at an independent commercial farmer site equipped with project meteorological and soil sensing, supported by physiological, proximal, UAV and Sentinel observations
objectives.measurable_output: Prospective validation dataset; unseen-environment benchmark; spatial scaling assessment; limited-recalibration protocol if required
objectives.source_ref: Pack §1.1.8 (O3 row); §3.1 WP3 (first complete tomato season within M4-M18, MS3 at M18)
objectives.note: RQ3 (which relationships remain stable under blocked unseen-year validation and prospective transfer to the commercial field) and H2 (transferability hypothesis) are what the prospective validation tests. Links Inferred.

objectives.title: Operationalise validated outputs in a crop-configurable DrR architecture through continuous Krumatic software development and AgroVIR requirements feedback, followed by industrial evaluation in M25-M30
objectives.measurable_output: Web MVP with validated processing-tomato module; irrigation-attention output; crop-extension specification; AgroVIR requirements/interoperability report; post-MSCA integration and exploitation roadmap
objectives.source_ref: Pack §1.1.8 (O4 row); §3.1 WP4 (M1-M24, MS4 at M24) and WP5 (M25-M30, MS5 at M30)
objectives.note: RQ5 (incremental implementation in a crop-configurable web MVP meeting performance gates and AgroVIR usability/interoperability requirements) and H4 (operational-relevance hypothesis) are O4's question and bet. Links Inferred.

research_questions_ref: RQ1-RQ5 are carried verbatim in project_brief/concept_note.md (Pack §1.1.6); hypotheses H1-H4 likewise (Pack §1.1.7). This file links; it does not restate.

central_challenge.statement: Can a water-stress signal discovered in a data-rich processing-tomato system remain biologically meaningful across seasons and sensing scales, survive prospective validation under real farmer conditions, and be encoded in a crop-configurable decision-support framework that can later be adapted to other irrigated high-value horticultural crops?
